long_biography.plain_text:
Born in 1978 to a Greek immigrant family in Sweden, Georgiadis completed commercial secondary school and military service in Greece. He returned to Sweden and formed a contracting and renovation firm, despite initial difficulty opening a bank account. More than two decades of reinvestment moved the business from project work into direct asset ownership, management and development.

Family-held properties supplied Stenhus Fastigheter’s initial portfolio before its stock-market listing, after which Georgiadis became chief executive. In Greece, a Sterner affiliate recapitalised the troubled Pasal Development, gaining control of the vehicle later renamed Premia. Georgiadis now oversees a cross-border portfolio and combines controlling shareholder influence with day-to-day operating leadership and listed-company governance.

proposed_details.existing_value:
According to the classification society RINA, the yacht is registered under a Greek company named VIA MARINA SINGLE MEMBER SA. The primary point of contact for the owning company is Elias Georgiadis, a 45-year-old individual with Greek-Swedish citizenship. Mr. Georgiadis holds the position of President and CEO at Sterner Stenhus and is also a board member in several of the group's companies. Furthermore, he serves as the Chairman of the Board at Premia Properties SA, a real estate company specializing in real estate development, construction, and management.

In 2020, Mr. Georgiadis made the acquisition of Pasal Development, a Greek real estate company previously owned by the Theodoridis family. Following the acquisition, he renamed it Premia Properties. Interestingly, the Greek media referred to him as the "white knight" in relation to this acquisition, which likely served as inspiration for naming the yacht "White Knight."
